question: 若要求所购U盘总容量达到32GB，请问调整后的订单总金额是多少？

steps.description: Locate the product name in the item list section of the receipt
Read the unit price value from the price column in the item list
Extract the purchased quantity from the quantity column in the item list
Find the original receipt total amount displayed on the receipt
Identify the target capacity requirement from the question text
Calculate the existing total capacity by multiplying quantity by unit capacity
Determine total USBs needed to reach target capacity
Calculate additional USBs required by subtracting existing from total needed
Compute cost of additional USBs by multiplying additional quantity by unit price
Calculate final order total by adding additional USB cost to original receipt total
